item.name: 01 — Authentication
item.description: Supabase Auth is accessed only through the application API. Registration verification confirms the email; login verification populates Postman's cookie jar.

request.description: Creates the Supabase Auth user and atomically provisions the default workspace, owner membership, profile, preferences, workspace profile, onboarding progress, and audit event.

exec: pm.test('Registered or duplicate is handled', () => pm.expect([201, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code));

request.description: Verifies the six-digit Gmail registration code and confirms the account. This does not create a login session.
Sends a six-digit application-owned code through Gmail SMTP. Copy it into the otp environment variable.
Verifies the Gmail OTP and establishes the Supabase SSR cookie session.
Rotates/refreshes the cookie session. Requires a valid refresh cookie in Postman's cookie jar.
Returns authenticated identity, active workspace, membership, permissions, preferences, and onboarding.
Revokes the local refresh session and clears the application session cookies. Idempotent for an already logged-out caller.
Always returns a generic response. Open the recovery email, copy the code query parameter from its redirect URL, and set resetCode in the environment.
Exchanges the one-time PKCE recovery code, changes the password, and signs out other sessions.
Returns a generic response and is rate limited.
Same full user/workspace context as Auth Me.
Strict allowlist: only displayName is accepted. userId, workspaceId, role, and permissions are rejected.
Verifies the current password, updates it, and revokes other sessions.
Resume the current user/workspace onboarding state after login.
Company changes are permitted only for owner/admin membership. Workspace scope is derived from the cookie session, never from this body.
Returns real workspace/permission/notification context plus explicitly marked temporary populated Project/BOQ dashboard values.
